metadata.title: Incident Response

props.name: capability
props.remarks: Business capability for coordinated response to security incidents.

props.name: technology-domain
props.remarks: Security operations and incident response technologies.

props.name: architecture-pattern
props.remarks: Structured, repeatable security incident handling and coordination pattern.

props.name: threat-framework
props.remarks: Incident response activities are triggered by detection of ATT&CK-aligned adversary behavior.

props.name: defense-framework
props.remarks: Incident response aligns to D3FEND containment, remediation, and recovery techniques.

metadata.remarks: Incident Response defines the capability to formally identify, contain, remediate, and coordinate the response to security incidents. Control implementation is expressed at the capability level to support audit traceability and operational clarity.

components.title: Incident Identification and Classification
components.description: Formal recognition, declaration, and categorization of security incidents.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Security events are evaluated and formally declared as incidents according to documented criteria.

components.title: Containment and Remediation
components.description: Actions to limit the impact of incidents and remediate affected systems and data.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Containment and eradication actions are taken to limit incident impact and restore services.
Remediation actions and lessons learned are incorporated into incident response improvements.

components.title: Coordination and Communication
components.description: Structured coordination and communication with internal and external stakeholders.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Incident status and required notifications are communicated to stakeholders and external entities.
